subject: english
question:
**Choose the correct meaning of the given idiom.**

A skeleton in the cupboard

options.text: A popular fact which is not hidden
A popular fact to be kept secret
An embarrassing fact not to be kept secret
An embarrassing fact to be kept secret

solution: The correct answer is option 4), i.e., "An embarrassing fact to be kept secret." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__ __ • Let’s look at the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase: • The phrase 'A skeleton in the cupboard' means 'a discreditable or embarrassing fact that someone wishes to keep secret.' (एक बदनाम या शर्मनाक तथ्य जिसे कोई गुप्त रखना चाहता है) • *Example*: • *​They say every family **a skeleton in the cupboard.*** • Hence, the only possible answer is option 4, 'An embarrassing fact to be kept secret,' which exactly resembles the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase. Correct meaning:__ *An embarrassing fact to be kept secret.* 38:T13e2,
